name: luxury-brand-photo-reel
description: Assembles a polished, music-driven social media video reel from 3–5 user-uploaded product or showroom photos. The creative pattern uses a static-image slideshow format (no motion graphics, no voiceover) with editorial-clean text overlays, warm-gold-on-dark typography, and a low-volume luxury instrumental track to create a high-end "lookbook" feel.
